hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: Bengaluru's Heart, A Century of Flavor.
hero.subtitle: Savor the iconic Benne Dose and timeless South Indian delicacies, cherished across generations since 1920 at Central Tiffin Room.

about.title: A Century of Culinary Tradition at Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: CTR, also known as Central Tiffin Rooms, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages. CTR’s rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers, Mr. Sanjeev Poojari, and the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory.
about.paragraph2: If there’s one thing that mirrors the brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been showering us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years. For Central Tiffin Room, it's more than just food; it's the emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together, serving up the city's best Benne Dose with an essence of nostalgia in every bite. Our 104-year-old eatery continues to cast its vintage charm, delivering the most delicious Benne Doses to the old town of Bengaluru, retaining the same authentic taste all along the way.
